title: Ganbare Goemon Kirakira Dōchū: Boku ga Dancer ni Natta Wake - Water Road
description:
Another of planet Aquann's background. This one has a distinction, because it has a floating Mt. Fuji in the background.

Massive update: Reripped from scratch, background is more accurate and complete, at the expense of using extra tiles.

Reripped the HDMA gradient, now it's more accurate. Insert it with the UberASM Tool 2.1.

Now, the layer 3 planets are included, as well.

A patch, like the RAM Toggled Status Bar (& IRQ) may be needed, since the vanilla status bar cut offs the layer 3 tilemap.
